# Workspace guidance

- This is a dependency-free, single-page portfolio built with semantic HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript in `index.html`.
- Preserve the responsive layout, keyboard accessibility, and reduced-motion support when editing.
- Do not invent employers, dates, credentials, projects, or personal contact details; keep placeholders until the owner supplies verified information.
- Preview by opening `index.html` in a browser. There is no package manager or build step.
